# Review — PAN-5219
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — `needs-you-push-service.test.ts` still expects `url: '/m'` for a merge.failed edge; CI test-shard (3/4) is red on this HEAD

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5219-review-998d382c
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5219/.pan/review/agent-pan-5219-review-998d382c/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5219 · /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5219

- HEAD reviewed: 998d382c864acdbe7f50fcae9a2315a872c90c9f
- Base: 99517e495abf2a663eed648e451efca7e5c13650 (merge-base with origin/main); no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] Existing push-service test not updated for the new edge URL — `src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/needs-you-push-service.test.ts:146`
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: validation gap (stale test) caused by this PR; in_pr_scope
- Trigger and changed-code connection: `src/lib/push/classify.ts` line 234 now sets `url: phoneIssueSheetPath(issueId, { kind: entryType, at: … })` for every `pipeline.journal` edge (WI-2, FR-1). The service-level test "sends a failed notification for a pipeline.journal merge.failed event" still asserts `url: '/m'` at the committed HEAD (`git show HEAD:…` line 146).
- Expected / observed / impact: expected the test to assert the new sheet path. Observed: the test fails, so the normal project test command is red and the PR cannot merge.
- Evidence: CI `test-shard (3/4)` on this exact HEAD (job 132314187549) fails with exactly this test: `FAIL src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/needs-you-push-service.test.ts > needs-you push service (PAN-2354) > sends a failed notification for a pipeline.journal merge.failed event` (1 failed, 6763 passed). Reproduced locally with `npx vitest run src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/needs-you-push-service.test.ts`: `- "url": "/m"` / `+ "url": "/m/pipeline?issue=PAN-7&event=merge.failed&at=2026-11-01T00%3A00%3A00.000Z"`. The plan's WI-2 verify list named only `classify.test.ts` and `dispatcher.test.ts`, so planning missed this caller.
- Note: while this review ran, the working tree gained an **uncommitted** edit to this test that expects `phoneIssueSheetPath('PAN-7', { kind: 'merge.failed', at: '2026-11-01T00:00:00.000Z' })`. That edit is the right fix, but reviews evaluate the committed HEAD; it must be committed and pushed, and CI must go green.
- Fix: commit that test update (import `phoneIssueSheetPath` from `@overdeck/contracts` in the test), push, and confirm `test-shard (3/4)` passes.

## Non-blocking Findings

- `~` [correctness] **A soft-failed check-runs read shows "No checks reported" instead of falling back.** `fetchIssueCheckRuns` (`src/lib/overdeck/pull-requests.ts` lines 459-472) answers HTTP 200 when `gh api …/check-runs` fails (rate limit, auth, timeout). It sets `pr` and a zeroed `summary`, and it adds `error: 'gh api check-runs failed: …'`. `isCheckRunsResponse` (`issueSheetData.ts`) accepts that body. Then `checksText` takes the `summary.total === 0` branch and shows "No checks reported", even when `derived.pr.checks` is `red`. D-8 says "When check-runs failed or is invalid, fall back to `derived.pr.checks`". This is an implementation defect against D-8. The trigger is a GitHub API failure, which is common under quota pressure, so the sheet can hide failing checks. Fix: treat a body with a non-empty `error` as a failure. Throw in `fetchCheckRuns`, or have `isCheckRunsResponse`/`checksText` ignore it. Then add a test with `{ pr, summary: zeros, error: '…' }` plus `checks: 'red'` that expects "Checks failed".
- `?` [requirements] Bare absolute file paths in a description (`/home/…/foo.ts`) make `ChatMarkdown` call the `resolveFilePathExists` WS RPC once per path in the browser phone view. The native app skips it (`useFilePathExists.ts` line 60). It is a read-only stat that runs once per path and does not poll, and FR-11 explicitly allows `ChatMarkdown` behavior inside the description subtree. Noted for completeness.
- `~` [requirements] **Section order differs from D-11.** D-11 orders the `dl` as Phase, State, Needs you, Agent, then Cost, then Pull request/Checks, then Description, then Project/Labels/Updated. `MobileIssueSheet.tsx` renders Phase, State, Needs you, **Project**, Pull request, Checks, Agent, Cost, Description, Labels, Updated. No AC tests the order and every section is present (screenshots confirm), so this is advisory. Either reorder to D-11 or record the change in the spec.
- `~` [requirements/process] **WI-3 implementation checkpoint and D-16 screenshots are not in the PR body.** WI-3 asks the PR body to record whether a cold load of `/m/pipeline` works on a simulator/emulator, or to say that no device was reachable. D-16 asks that the two PNGs be linked from the PR body. The PR body has only the AC checklist. The PNGs exist under `apps/mobile/acceptance/`. Add both notes to the PR body.
- `~` [correctness] **CostSection shows stale data after a refetch error.** It renders from `query.data`, so after one success and a later failed refetch, polling stops (correct, NFR-2) but the old figure stays rather than "Cost not available". `PrChecksSection` and `AgentRow` use `isSuccess` and fall back correctly. Low impact; consider `query.isError ? 'Cost not available' : …` first for consistency.
- `?` [correctness, pre-existing] `JOURNAL_EDGES[entryType]` is a plain-object lookup, so an entry type such as `toString` would match `Object.prototype`. This existed before the PR; the new URL path only carries such a value into `event=`, where `parsePhoneIssueEvent` (hasOwnProperty) rejects it. Not reachable from real journal writers.
- `?` [performance] Each open sheet polls `/check-runs` every 60 s (two `gh` calls per poll) and `/costs` every 30 s (a sync SQLite `UPPER(issue_id)` aggregate). Both routes were already polled by the desktop issue view; the phone adds one bounded poller per open sheet that stops on error. No measured impact; advisory only.
- Screenshot A shows "Merged PR #90010" next to "#90010 · Open" because the fixture's derived state is `in-review` with `merged: false`. This is fixture data, not a code defect; real derived state updates after a merge.
- Stub-UI scanner hit `IssueSheetSections.tsx:176` (`useState(false)`) is a false positive: `setExpanded` is toggled by the Show more/Show less button (lines ~191-197), and tests assert the toggle.

### Dimensions
- **Correctness:** one blocker (stale service test). Classifier, router, parser and sheet logic traced end to end; no other defects found.
- **Security:** new phone scopes are read-only GETs at `read:state`/`read:costs`, matching D-12; issue id validated by `parseIssueId` in both routes; description rendered by sanitizing `ChatMarkdown`; `event` text never reaches the screen unparsed; ntfy Click URL adds only id/kind/time (PAN-2354 public-title rule holds). No findings.
- **Performance:** bounded pollers that stop on error; advisory only.
- **Requirements/UX:** all FRs implemented; D-11 order and PR-body checkpoint are advisory gaps.

### Acceptance criteria

| AC-4 | met | `route-scopes.test.ts`, `telemetry-docs.test.ts`, `telemetry-client-route.test.ts` pass |
| AC-5 | met | `MobileIssueSheet.test.tsx` passes; Linear screenshot |
| AC-6 | met | `issueSheetData.test.ts` / sheet tests pass; screenshot shows "work · opus · claude-code / Live" |

| AC-12 | met | docs and changelog present; CI lint groups green |

## Verification
- CI on exact HEAD 998d382c: build, lint, lint-group (core/effect/state/skills), mobile-android, integrations, clean install: pass. `test-shard (3/4)`: **fail** (blocker above). test-shards 1, 2, 4: pass. `test-e2e`, `bare-host-*`: pending.
- `overdeck/verification` gate: passed (typecheck + lint; tests on CI).
- `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics`: reused CI `lint-group (effect)` pass for this HEAD.
- Focused local runs (root): `npx vitest run tests/unit/contracts/phone-issue-event.test.ts tests/unit/lib/push/classify.test.ts src/dashboard/server/__tests__/route-scopes.test.ts tests/unit/telemetry-docs.test.ts tests/unit/contracts/telemetry-client-route.test.ts` → 58/58 pass.
- Frontend: `npx vitest run --configLoader runner MobileIssueSheet.test.tsx issueSheetData.test.ts MobileApp.test.tsx` → 85/85 pass.
- Mobile: `npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/shell/__tests__/notificationLink.test.ts` → 5/5 pass.
- `npx vitest run src/dashboard/server/services/__tests__/needs-you-push-service.test.ts tests/unit/lib/push/` → 1 failed (the blocker), 143 passed.
- Playwright not run locally (needs a build and an isolated dashboard); relied on the committed screenshots and pending CI.

## Scope Note
The branch moved while this review ran. Commit `d3fa499600d` ("fix(cloister): update needs-you-push-service test for issue-sheet URLs") now sits on top of the reviewed HEAD. The PR head is `321f27e87c7f` and the local HEAD is `c39437dedfb`; both add only that test edit plus xbrief bookkeeping (`git diff 998d382c 321f27e8 --stat`). That commit appears to fix the blocker. This verdict applies to `998d382c` only, so the next cycle should confirm that `test-shard (3/4)` is green on the new head. That cycle should also address the check-runs soft-failure advisory (D-8 fallback).

Additional verification notes:
- `lint-group (effect)` runs `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics` (`scripts/run-lint-group.mjs` line 16), so the CI pass covers it.
- FR-3 is met at the parser level. `ShellApp.tsx` line 129 feeds `parseNotificationLink` into `pendingOpen`, `navigate` defaults to `location.assign` (line 100), and the machine view mounts on `pathname.startsWith('/m')` (line 322). A cold Capacitor load of `/m/pipeline` is still unverified on a device, and the PR body does not record the WI-3 checkpoint.
- The test diffs were read: the GET-only assertion (WI-9), the "`/costs` fetched once after 403" test (WI-7) and the zero-spend test are present. No `.only`, `skip` or `skipIf` was added.
- AC-11: CI `test-e2e` was still pending for `998d382c` when the head moved, so it is unverified on CI.
